scans.name: eks-payments
notes: kube-system / kube-public / kube-node-lease workloads skipped (use --include-system to scan them)

open.evidence: no multi-region CloudTrail trail is logging: control-plane activity is unrecorded
open.recommended_remediation: Create a multi-region trail (ideally an organization trail) delivering to a locked-down log bucket

open.evidence: bucket is publicly readable via bucket policy, and Block Public Access does not stop it
open.recommended_remediation: Enable Block Public Access on the bucket; serve public content through CloudFront with origin access control
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — S3 Block Public Access

open.evidence: bucket is publicly readable via ACL grant to everyone, and Block Public Access does not stop it
open.recommended_remediation: Enable Block Public Access on the bucket; serve public content through CloudFront with origin access control
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — S3 Block Public Access

open.evidence: all ports open to 0.0.0.0/0
open.recommended_remediation: Remove the any-any rule; allow only the ports the workload serves, from known sources

open.evidence: data-store port(s) open to 0.0.0.0/0: PostgreSQL 5432
open.recommended_remediation: Databases must never face the internet: restrict to the application tier's security group

open.evidence: role trust policy allows Principal "*" with no Condition — any AWS account can assume it
open.recommended_remediation: Restrict the trust policy to named principals; add aws:PrincipalOrgID or sts:ExternalId conditions

open.evidence: the root account has an active access key
open.recommended_remediation: Delete root access keys; use IAM roles for all programmatic access

open.evidence: the root account has no MFA device
open.recommended_remediation: Enable hardware MFA on the root account and lock the device away

open.evidence: hostPath volume mounts the node's /var/run/docker.sock — container breakout / node takeover
open.recommended_remediation: Replace hostPath with a PersistentVolume, ConfigMap or projected volume

open.evidence: container 'agent' runs privileged: full access to the node
open.recommended_remediation: Drop privileged; grant only the specific capability the workload needs
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.1 / Pod Security Standards baseline

open.evidence: view is granted to Group system:authenticated (everyone / anonymous)
open.recommended_remediation: Remove the binding; grant roles to named users, groups or service accounts

open.evidence: runs as service account batch/ci-deployer, which is bound to cluster-admin, and mounts its token
open.recommended_remediation: Give the workload a dedicated least-privilege service account; never mount a cluster-admin token into a pod

open.evidence: postgres instance is publicly accessible
open.recommended_remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible=false and place the instance in private subnets

open.evidence: bucket policy allows Principal "*" with no Condition
open.recommended_remediation: Restrict the policy to named principals or a CloudFront origin access control
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — S3 Block Public Access

open.evidence: data-store port(s) open to 0.0.0.0/0: PostgreSQL 5432
open.recommended_remediation: Databases must never face the internet: restrict to the application tier's security group

open.evidence: role trust policy allows Principal "*"
open.recommended_remediation: Trust named principals only; add aws:PrincipalOrgID or sts:ExternalId conditions

open.evidence: hostPath volume mounts the node's / — container breakout / node takeover
open.recommended_remediation: Replace hostPath with a PersistentVolume, ConfigMap or projected volume

open.evidence: container 'shipper' runs privileged: full access to the node
open.recommended_remediation: Drop privileged; grant only the specific capability the workload needs
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.1 / Pod Security Standards baseline

open.evidence: data-store port(s) open to 0.0.0.0/0: Redis 6379
open.recommended_remediation: Databases must never face the internet: restrict to the application tier's security group

open.evidence: instance metadata allows IMDSv1 on an internet-facing instance (SSRF → role credentials)
open.recommended_remediation: Require IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required); set the account default for new instances

open.evidence: account-level S3 Block Public Access is not fully enabled
open.recommended_remediation: Turn on all four account-level Block Public Access settings; exempt specific buckets only by exception
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — S3 Block Public Access

open.evidence: remote-admin port(s) open to 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0: SSH 22
open.recommended_remediation: Close SSH/RDP to the internet; use SSM Session Manager or a bastion behind VPN

open.evidence: policy allows privilege-escalation actions on Resource "*": iam:passrole
open.recommended_remediation: Scope these actions to specific resources, or move them behind a break-glass role

open.evidence: role is assumable from external account 999999999999 without an sts:ExternalId condition
open.recommended_remediation: Confirm account 999999999999 is an approved vendor; add it to trusted accounts or require sts:ExternalId

open.evidence: role has an inline policy allowing Action "*" on Resource "*"
open.recommended_remediation: Replace the inline wildcard with a scoped managed policy

open.evidence: IAM user holds full administrator rights (directly, via a group, or inline)
open.recommended_remediation: Remove standing admin from users; grant it through a role assumed with MFA and logged

open.evidence: console password enabled but no MFA device
open.recommended_remediation: Enforce MFA for every console user (deny-without-MFA policy)

open.evidence: container 'gen' adds capabilities SYS_ADMIN
open.recommended_remediation: Remove added capabilities; drop ALL and add back only what is proven necessary

open.evidence: pod shares the node's hostNetwork, hostPID
open.recommended_remediation: Remove hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC; use a Service or a node agent with a narrow scope

open.evidence: cluster-admin bound to ServiceAccount batch/ci-deployer
open.recommended_remediation: Replace cluster-admin with a scoped ClusterRole; keep cluster-admin for break-glass only

open.evidence: grants every verb on every resource ('*' / '*') (bound via ClusterRoleBinding/ops-team)
open.recommended_remediation: Narrow the rule to the verbs and resources the subject actually uses

open.evidence: container 'gen' explicitly runs as UID 0
open.recommended_remediation: Run as a non-root UID and set runAsNonRoot: true
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.7 / Pod Security Standards restricted

open.evidence: container 'gen' has plaintext secret-like env vars in the manifest: DB_PASSWORD
open.recommended_remediation: Move the values to a Secret (or an external secret store) and reference them with valueFrom

open.evidence: instance metadata allows IMDSv1 on an internet-facing instance (SSRF → role credentials)
open.recommended_remediation: Require IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required); set the account default for new instances

open.evidence: database storage is not encrypted at rest
open.recommended_remediation: Restore from an encrypted snapshot copy; encryption cannot be enabled in place

open.evidence: EKS API server endpoint is reachable from the whole internet
open.recommended_remediation: Disable the public endpoint, or restrict public_access_cidrs to office / VPN ranges

open.evidence: Block Public Access disabled: block_public_policy, restrict_public_buckets
open.recommended_remediation: Keep all four Block Public Access settings true; serve public content via CloudFront
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — S3 Block Public Access

open.evidence: policy allows Action "*" on Resource "*"
open.recommended_remediation: Write least-privilege statements scoped to the actions and resources needed

open.evidence: container 'shipper' has plaintext secret-like env vars in the manifest: SPLUNK_TOKEN
open.recommended_remediation: Move the values to a Secret (or an external secret store) and reference them with valueFrom

open.evidence: log file integrity validation is off: tampering would go unnoticed
open.recommended_remediation: Enable log file validation on the trail

open.evidence: EBS encryption by default is off in this region
open.recommended_remediation: Enable EBS encryption by default (aws ec2 enable-ebs-encryption-by-default)

open.evidence: EBS volume is not encrypted
open.recommended_remediation: Snapshot, copy the snapshot with encryption, and replace the volume

open.evidence: instance metadata allows IMDSv1
open.recommended_remediation: Require IMDSv2 (HttpTokens=required); set the account default for new instances

open.evidence: GuardDuty is not enabled in this region
open.recommended_remediation: Enable GuardDuty in every region and forward findings to AEGIS

open.evidence: customer-managed symmetric key has automatic rotation off
open.recommended_remediation: Enable automatic key rotation
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — KMS key rotation

open.evidence: the VPC default security group has 1 inbound / 1 outbound rule(s)
open.recommended_remediation: Remove all rules from default security groups; use purpose-built groups

open.evidence: VPC has no flow logs: network forensics after an incident is impossible
open.recommended_remediation: Enable VPC flow logs (at least REJECT) to CloudWatch Logs or S3
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — VPC flow logging

open.evidence: access key 1 is 1005 days old
open.recommended_remediation: Rotate keys at least every 90 days, or replace with role-based access

open.evidence: console password unused for 154 days
open.recommended_remediation: Disable the console password; remove the user if it is no longer needed

open.evidence: container 'gen' binds a hostPort on the node
open.recommended_remediation: Expose through a Service instead of hostPort

open.evidence: 2 workload(s) and no NetworkPolicy: any pod can reach any pod
open.recommended_remediation: Add a default-deny ingress/egress NetworkPolicy, then allow the flows the app needs

open.evidence: 1 workload(s) and no NetworkPolicy: any pod can reach any pod
open.recommended_remediation: Add a default-deny ingress/egress NetworkPolicy, then allow the flows the app needs

open.evidence: container 'gen' does not set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
open.recommended_remediation: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.6 / Pod Security Standards restricted

open.evidence: container 'sh' does not set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
open.recommended_remediation: Set allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.6 / Pod Security Standards restricted

open.evidence: can exec into pods (bound via RoleBinding/payments/support)
open.recommended_remediation: Narrow the rule to the verbs and resources the subject actually uses

open.evidence: can read Secrets (bound via RoleBinding/payments/support)
open.recommended_remediation: Narrow the rule to the verbs and resources the subject actually uses

open.evidence: container 'agent' may run as root (no runAsNonRoot / runAsUser)
open.recommended_remediation: Set runAsNonRoot: true and a non-zero runAsUser
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.7 / Pod Security Standards restricted

open.evidence: container 'sh' may run as root (no runAsNonRoot / runAsUser)
open.recommended_remediation: Set runAsNonRoot: true and a non-zero runAsUser
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.7 / Pod Security Standards restricted

open.evidence: customer-managed symmetric key has automatic rotation off
open.recommended_remediation: Enable automatic key rotation
open.control: CIS AWS Foundations v2.0 — KMS key rotation

open.evidence: container 'shipper' may run as root (no runAsNonRoot / runAsUser)
open.recommended_remediation: Set runAsNonRoot: true and a non-zero runAsUser
open.control: CIS Kubernetes v1.9 5.2.7 / Pod Security Standards restricted

open.evidence: trail logs are not encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key
open.recommended_remediation: Encrypt trail delivery with a customer-managed KMS key

open.evidence: minimum password length is 8
open.recommended_remediation: Require at least 14 characters

open.evidence: server access logging is off
open.recommended_remediation: Enable server access logging or CloudTrail S3 data events for this bucket

open.evidence: no default encryption configuration on the bucket
open.recommended_remediation: Set default encryption to SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key for regulated data

open.evidence: versioning is off: a ransomware overwrite or delete is unrecoverable
open.recommended_remediation: Enable versioning (and MFA delete / Object Lock for backups)

open.evidence: 1 managed + 0 inline policies attached directly to the user
open.recommended_remediation: Attach permissions to groups or roles and add the user to the group

open.evidence: user has two active access keys
open.recommended_remediation: Keep one active key per user; delete the other once rotation is done

open.evidence: 1 workload(s) run in the default namespace
open.recommended_remediation: Move workloads into dedicated namespaces with their own RBAC and policies

open.evidence: uses the namespace's default service account with its token auto-mounted
open.recommended_remediation: Create a dedicated service account, or set automountServiceAccountToken: false
